steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Participants tab, which is the required starting state for surrogate-bid cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Enter and save a buyer-side surrogate bid with the specified decimal price.
Verify that Procol accepted and submitted the surrogate bid.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to inspect the recorded bid and totals.
Verify that the recorded unit rate is exactly 95.75.
Verify that the line amount and Sum Total are calculated correctly from the recorded rate and quantity.
